name: openai-compatible-models
description: Adds any OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions server (Strata, llama.cpp-class, vLLM) to the VS Code model picker and agent mode via the stable Language Model Chat Provider API. Fully local BYOK.

strata.baseUrl.description: OpenAI-compatible base URL of your endpoint. Machine scope on purpose: this extension auto-attaches your API key to requests, so a workspace-level setting could redirect the key to an attacker host. In the ai-lab stack the box sets this in server-scope Machine settings (e.g. http://systemd-strata:8080/v1).

strata.apiKey.description: API key for the endpoint. Leave empty to read STRATA_API_KEY from the server process environment (e.g. injected by a quadlet EnvironmentFile). Machine scope: never set per-workspace; note plaintext settings flow through Settings Sync.

strata.contextWindow.description: Fallback context window (tokens) when the server does not report meta.n_ctx per model.

strata.maxOutputTokens.description: Max output tokens per response. Keep generous: reasoning models share this budget with thinking.

strata.toolCalling.description: Declare tool-calling support (agent mode lists only tool-capable models).

strata.imageInput.description: Fallback vision flag when the server does not report architecture.input_modalities.

strata.maxImageBytes.description: Skip image inputs larger than this many raw bytes (default 10 MB) to avoid memory spikes and oversized requests; a notice is shown in chat when an image is skipped.

strata.modelAllowlist.description: If non-empty, only expose these model ids from GET {baseUrl}/models. Machine scope so a workspace cannot shape model discovery.
